discoveries.title: Cached pyramid path skips all mini-evals (0/7)
discoveries.body: p2_train.py short-circuits the in-loop p2_mini_eval.run_mini_eval when --cached-feats is set, logging mini_eval_skipped reason=encoder=wan22_cached at every scheduled step. Mini-eval requires a live encoder forward; restoring it for cached runs is Phase-4 work.

discoveries.title: Wall time dominated by data + head, not encoder
discoveries.body: 110 min / 15 000 steps = ~440 ms/step at 8×H100 with bs=64 effective. Cache lookup eliminates the 0.6-1.0 s/step ViT forward seen on 4RC live runs; remaining cost is pyramid gather + head forward + Kabsch GT fit.

discoveries.title: ADD-S converges to ~5.8 mm aggregate; rot error sub-degree
discoveries.body: 3-sequence in-distribution mean: obj ADD-S 5.85 ± 0.28 mm, rot 0.93 ± 0.31°, trans 5.65 ± 0.51 mm. Object pose head is well-converged. Hand metrics (vert 23.7, joint 22.5 mm) are an order higher; the gap reflects the training-loss-vs-metric definition gap (hand point loss is per-token weighted distance, eval is per-frame mean L2).

discoveries.title: pt-wr11kin9 logs are empty on disk
discoveries.body: Direct training-loss curve comparison against the 4RC live anchor is not possible — the launcher's tee buffering left logs/hoi3r_v2_p2_4gpu/seed0/train.log empty. Only ACP wall-time + args.json survive for that run.
